description: Asking-price statistics for apartments for sale in a Bulgarian city or district on imotai.bg — the same figures as imotai.bg/ceni and imotai.bg/facts. Use medianPricePerSqm, pricePerSqm (P25/P50/P75), sampleSize, asOf and priceSource for the price. catalogue.* (count, average total price, price quartiles, by-room breakdown) and neighbouringDistricts are averages over the smaller ImotAI catalogue — label them as such. Legacy top-level count/avgPrice/avgPricePerSqm/price/byRooms are kept for compatibility (see deprecatedFields; avgPricePerSqm is the median when priceSource is market_sweep). Returns { available: false } below 8 offers.

district.description: District slug or name from list_districts; omit for city-level stats.
